verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine that provides an OpenAI-compatible API, batching, quantization and similar runtime features. An integrated document-drafting workspace with autosave is an end-user application feature outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows vLLM ships such a workspace. Tool calling and structured outputs are model-serving primitives, not a document editor.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
